title: Find The Duplicate Number
description: Given an array of integers nums containing n + 1 integers where each integer is in the range [1, n] inclusive, find the duplicate number using Floyd's Cycle Detection.
pseudocode:
1. slow = nums[0]
2. fast = nums[0]
3. do { slow = nums[slow]; fast = nums[nums[fast]] } while (slow != fast)
4. slow = nums[0]
5. while (slow != fast) { slow = nums[slow]; fast = nums[fast] }
6. return slow

steps.note: Move slow one step and fast two steps
Cycle detected: slow and fast meet at value 2 (index 3)
Reset slow to start to find the entrance of the cycle
Move both pointers at same speed
Pointers meet at index 3, which is the duplicate value 2
